source("R/Utility.R")

# Example 1 — Classification (L=2 groups, C=3 (K=2) classes)

```{r ex1-dgp}
set.seed(111)

# ---- helpers ----
softmax <- function(x) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)                    # n × C
  x_max <- apply(x, 1, max)
  exp_x <- exp(x - x_max)
  exp_x / rowSums(exp_x)
}

# ---- settings ----
n <- 100; p <- 5; L <- 2; N <- 1000
K <- 2  # as in your Python; final number of classes will be C = K + 1

# ---- data ----
Xlist <- replicate(L, matrix(rnorm(n * p, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = n, ncol = p), simplify = FALSE)
X0    <- matrix(rnorm(N * p, mean = 0.1, sd = 1), nrow = N, ncol = p)

beta_list <- replicate(
  L,
  cbind(rep(0, p), matrix(rnorm(p * K, mean = 0, sd = 0.25), nrow = p, ncol = K)),
  simplify = FALSE
)

logits_list <- Map(function(X, beta) {
  M <- X %*% beta                       # n × (K+1)
  M - mean(M)                           # center by overall mean (scalar)
}, Xlist, beta_list)

probs_list <- lapply(logits_list, softmax)  # each: n × (K+1)


ylist <- lapply(probs_list, function(P) {
  apply(P, 1, function(prob) sample.int(ncol(P), size = 1, prob = prob) - 1L)
})


```






### Implementation
```{r ex1-implementation}
## fit cgdro
fit <- cgdro(Xlist, ylist, X0,
             family = "cls", f_learner = "linear", w_learner = "linear", split=TRUE)
inf <- infer(fit, M = 200, alpha = 0.05, parallel = TRUE, n_workers = 4, diag = TRUE)
```



### Results
```{r ex1-results}
summary(fit, infer = inf)

```

```{r ex1-results2}
summary(fit, infer = inf, index = c(1,3), class_index = c(2))

```

### Prediction
```{r ex1-prediction}
pred <- predict(fit)  # N x C matrix of predicted probabilities
head(pred$pred_proba)
```

```{r ex1-prediction2}
head(pred$pred)
```


# Example 2 — Regression (Low-dim, L=2 domains)
```{r ex0-dgp}
set.seed(0)
L <- 2
p <- 5

# Source distributions
mean_source <- rep(0, p)
cov_source  <- diag(p)

# --- Group 1 ---
n1 <- 100
X1 <- MASS::mvrnorm(n1, mu = mean_source, Sigma = cov_source)
b1 <- rep(0, p); b1[1:5] <- (1:5) / 20
Y1 <- as.numeric(X1 %*% b1 + rnorm(n1))

# --- Group 2 ---
n2 <- 100
X2 <- MASS::mvrnorm(n2, mu = mean_source, Sigma = cov_source)
b2 <- rev(2:6) / 20   # same as np.arange(6,1,-1)/20
Y2 <- as.numeric(X2 %*% b2 + rnorm(n2))

# --- Target (covariate shift: here same cov as sources) ---
n0 <- 100
X0 <- MASS::mvrnorm(n0, mu = rep(0, p), Sigma = cov_source)

Xlist <- list(X1, X2)
Ylist <- list(Y1, Y2)
```


### Implementation
```{r ex0-implementation}
fit <- cgdro(Xlist, Ylist, X0, loss_type = "reward",
             family = "reg_ld",  intercept = TRUE,
             delta = 0,  verbose = FALSE)
inf <- infer(fit, M = 200, alpha = 0.05)
```



### Results
```{r ex0-results}
summary(fit, infer=inf)
```

### Prediction
```{r ex0-prediction}
pred <- predict(fit)  # N x 1 vector of predicted values
head(pred)
```

# Example 3 — Regression (High-dim, L=2 domains)


```{r ex2-dgp}
set.seed(111)
## number of groups
L=2
## dimension
p=100

## mean vector for source
mean.source = rep(0, p)
## covariance matrix for source
A1gen <- function(rho,p){
  A1=matrix(0,p,p)
  for(i in 1:p){
    for(j in 1:p){
      A1[i,j]<-rho^(abs(i-j))
    }
  }
  return(A1)
}
cov.source = A1gen(0.6, p)

## 1st group's source data
n1 = 100
X1 = MASS::mvrnorm(n1, mu=mean.source, Sigma=cov.source)
# true coef for 1st group
b1 = rep(0, p)
b1[1:5] = seq(1,5)/20
b1[98:100] = c(0.5, -0.5, -0.5)
Y1 = X1%*%b1 + rnorm(n1)

## 2nd group's source data
n2 = 100
X2 = MASS::mvrnorm(n2, mu=mean.source, Sigma=cov.source)
# true coef for 2nd group
b2 = rep(0, p)
b2[6:10] = seq(1,5)/20
b2[98:100] = 0.5*c(0.5, -0.5, -0.5)
Y2 = X2%*%b2 + rnorm(n2)

## Target Data, covariate shift
n0 = 100
mean0 = rep(0.1, p)
cov0 = cov.source
X0 = MASS::mvrnorm(n0, mu=mean0, Sigma=cov0)

loading.mat = matrix(0, nrow=100, ncol=2) # dimension p=100
loading.mat[96:100, 1] = 0.4
loading.mat[99:100, 2] = 0.8
```



### Implementation
```{r ex2-implementation}
fit <- cgdro(list(X1,X2), list(Y1,Y2), X0 = X0,
             family = "reg_hd", 
             index = c(1,10,45,99,101), intercept = TRUE, intercept_loading = TRUE,
             delta = 0, lambda = "CV.min", verbose = TRUE)
inf <- infer(fit, M = 200, alpha = 0.05)
```




### Results
```{r ex2-results1}
summary(fit, infer=inf)
```


### Prediction
```{r ex2-prediction}
pred <- predict(fit)  # N x 1 vector of predicted values
head(pred)
```





# Example 4 — Regression (ML, L=2 domains)

```{r ex3-dgp}
set.seed(111)
L <- 2; p <- 5
mean_source <- rep(0, p); cov_source <- diag(p)
n1 <- 2000; n2 <- 2000; n0 <- 20000
X1 <- MASS::mvrnorm(n1, mean_source, cov_source)
X2 <- MASS::mvrnorm(n2, mean_source, cov_source)
b1 <- c(1,-1,0.5,0,0) + rnorm(p,0,0.1)
b2 <- c(1,0.5,-0.5,0,0) + rnorm(p,0,0.1)
Y1 <- (X1^3 %*% b1) + sin(X1 %*% b1) + pmin(pmax(exp(X1 %*% b1),0),1) + rnorm(n1)
Y2 <- (X2^3 %*% b2) + sin(X2 %*% b2) + pmin(pmax(exp(X2 %*% b2),0),1) + rnorm(n2)
X0 <- MASS::mvrnorm(n0, rep(0,p), cov_source)
Xlist <- list(X1, X2); Ylist <- list(Y1, Y2)

```




### Implementation
```{r ex3-implementation}
fit <- cgdro(Xlist, Ylist, X0, loss_type = "reward",
             family = "reg_ml", f_learner = "xgb", w_learner = "linear",
             bias_correct = TRUE,
             priors = NULL,
             ridge = 1e-8,
             seed = 123)
```

### Results
```{r ex3-results}
fit$weight_
```

### Prediction
```{r ex3-prediction}
pred <- predict(fit)  # N x 1 vector of predicted values
head(pred)
```
